visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Move the Rule into the Class
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The caller changes a public balance field and repeats the check "amount is positive and not more than the balance" before every withdrawal. Make the field private and put the rule in a withdraw method. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: With a private field the rule lives in exactly one place and cannot be bypassed. The callers say what they want (withdraw 80) and the class decides whether it is allowed.
